notes:
Summary: Mid-market product company focusing on retention & in-app help. Currently trialing Hosted API for NLU + personalized message generation; evaluating move to Dedicated for predictable latency and cost.

Context / quotes: - VP Product: "Need sub-200ms 95th p95 for instant in-app suggestions during peak hours or users will perceive lag." - Engineering: prefers model variants with quantization options; wary of too aggressive batching.

Hosted trial findings (engineering notes): - Trial period: 3 weeks (Feb) using hosted API endpoints. - Traffic observed: avg QPS 4, peak QPS 18 (minutes-long bursts during US business hours). - Daily requests ~3k-4k; DAU ~2.5k. - Token mix: prompt ~420 tokens avg, completion ~230 tokens avg => total ~650 tokens/request. - Percentage by workload: 62% chat/generation, 20% embeddings (search & personalization), 10% reranking, 8% misc evals. - 95th latency on hosted at trial: 240ms for short completions; strategic margin required to reach p95 <200ms for Dedicated.

POC / technical: - Ran 72-hour stress POC simulating 25 QPS sustained with 60 concurrent streams; cache hit rate (prefix KV) improved tail latency by ~18%. - Acceptance criteria for Dedicated: sustained 20 QPS with p95 <180ms on generation path; embeddings 99th <120ms. - SE (Priya) demoed fallback routing concept: when Dedicated overloaded, route to hosted-compatible smaller variant with controlled degradation.

Commercial / pricing convo: - Interested in committed capacity for cost predictability. Initial ask: committed monthly for 12 months; target spend $25k-60k/mo depending on GPU sizing. - Wants clear unit economics: cost/token by mode (hosted vs dedicated) and break-even point.

Security & compliance: - Require SOC2 attestation, SSO/SAML integration, audit logs forwarded to their SIEM, optional customer-managed KMS. - Data residency question: prefer US-only region for PII subsets; asked for written guarantee and log retention options.

Artifacts / refs: Fireflies call ff_49a2c8b3-call-20260218 (sales+eng), Drive proposal & security FAQ links above, Jira INF-4421 for integration blocker.
